div.head: CONTENTS
div.p:
LECTURE I.—Page 1.
GENESIS, I. 1.
In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

LECTURE II.—Page 15.
GENESIS, III. PART OF VER. 3.
God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

LECTURE III.—Page 25.
GENESIS v. 1.
This is the book of the generations of Adam.

LECTURE IV.—Page 37.
GENESIS, VII. PART OF VER. 13.
And Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.

LECTURE V.—Page 47.
GENESIS, VIII. PART OF VER. 1.
And God remembered Noah.

LECTURE VI.—Page 59.
GENESIS, XII. PART OF VER. 3.
And in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

LECTURE VII.—Page 69.
GENESIS, XIV. 18.
And Melchizedek, king of Salem, brought forth bread and wine; and he was the priest of the most high God.

LECTURE VIII.—Page 79.
GENESIS, XV. 6.
And he believed in the Lord, and he counted it to him for righteousness.

LECTURE IX.—Page 91.
GENESIS, XVII. 1.
And when Abram was ninety years old and mine, the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

LECTURE X.—Page 105.
GENESIS, XVIII. PART OF VER. 2.
And he life up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him.

LECTURE XI.—Page 115.
GENESIS, XXII. PART OF VER. 1.
And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham.

LECTURE XII.—Page 125.
GENESIS, XXIV. 4.
But thou shalt go unto my country and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

LECTURE XIII.—Page 135.
GENESIS, XXV. PART OF VER> 34.
Thus Esau despised his birthright.

LECTURE XIV.—Page 143.
GENESIS, XXVII. PART OF VER. 36.
He hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing.

LECTURE XV.—Page 153.
GENESIS, XXVIII. 1.
And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unot him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

LECTURE XVI.—Page 163.
GENESIS, XXXIII. 4.
And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they wept.

LECTURE XVII.—Page 173.
GENESIS, XXXVII. PART OF VER. 1.
And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger.

LECTURE XVIII.—Page 183.
GENESIS, XXXVII. 3, 4.
Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age; and he made him a coat of many colours; and when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unot him.

LECTURE XIX.—Page 193.
GENESIS XXXVII. PART OF VER. 13.
And he said unto him, Here am I.

LECTURE XX.—Page 203.
GENESIS, XXXIX. PART OF VER. 2.
And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man.

LECTURE XXI.—Page 215.
GENESIS, XLVIII. 11.
And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face; and, lo! God hath showed me also thy seed.
